result.question: Why does the king think Arameans left?

readings.answer: To hide in the field to capture them when they come out and then enter the city.
readings.support: to hide in the field | we will take them alive and enter the city.

readings.answer: Because they know the Israelites are starving.
readings.support: They know we are starving, so they have left the camp

assessments.reason: Matches the verse’s purpose clause: “to hide in the field… we will take them alive and enter the city,” which is to ambush the Israelites and conquer the city.
Also explicitly stated: “They know we are starving, so they have left the camp,” giving the cause the king cites for their leaving, which answers “why” in a different but text-supported way.

result.reason: The verse states both a cause (“They know we are starving”) and a purpose (“to… take them alive and enter the city”), so the question allows two distinct answers.
